"""Check preparation bytes, frozen implementation, exact prefix and document links."""

import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V157-spatial-rgb-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v157-spatial-rgb-preparation-v1.json'
output=repo/'docs/results/v157-spatial-rgb-preparation-verification-v1.json'
assert not output.exists()
publication=read(index)
assert len(publication['copies'])==10 and publication['source_texts']==30
for copy in publication['copies'].values():
    for role in ['original','public']:assert ref(copy[role]['path'])==copy[role]
    assert Path(copy['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copy['public']['path']).read_bytes()
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
bundle=read(publication['sources']['path'])
assert ref(publication['sources']['path'])==publication['sources']
assert len(bundle['source_texts'])==30 and len(bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'])==86
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
for p,h in bundle['unchanged_neural_hashes'].items():
    assert ref(p)['sha256']==ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
    assert ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
assert ref(bundle['new_module']['path'])==bundle['new_module']
assert ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic/late_spatial_rgb.py')['sha256']==bundle['new_module']['sha256']
ready=read(root/'readiness-audit-v1.json')
assert ready['finite_Adam_states_at10']==58 and ready['strict_raw_EMA_CPU_loads']==4
assert ready['restored_control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact_V156'] and not ready['CUDA_initialized']
assert ready['all58_parameters_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients']
assert ready['complete_rows']==ready['exact_control_trace_rows']==122
assert ref(ready['live_prefix']['path'])==ready['live_prefix']
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(ready['live_prefix']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
reference=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
assert len(rows)==122
for n,row in enumerate(rows):
    assert row['step']==n+1 and row['batch']==reference[n]['batch']
    assert row['arms']['local-control']==reference[n]['arms']['local-risk']
assert read(root/'objective-tests-v1.json')['tests']==45
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json')
assert parity['component_forward_evaluations']==84 and len(parity['rows'])==28
assert all(r['exact_zero_spatial_extension'] and r['exact_frozen_relative_forward_and_archived'] for r in parity['rows'])
design=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')
assert len(design['observations'])==822 and len(design['endpoints'])==4
assert design['new_component_forwards']==3288
for item in design['observations']:
    assert ref(item['arrays']['path'])==item['arrays'] and ref(item['parent']['path'])==item['parent']
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
      'docs/spatial-rgb-residual.md','diary/2026-11-03-21-20-55-v157-spatial-rgb.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        target=(p.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve()
        assert target==output or target.is_file(),(name,link)
        links+=1
save(output,{
    'status':'pass-immutable-preparation-sources-prefix-and-documents',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'publication':ref(index),
    'byte_exact_receipts':10,'source_texts':30,'unchanged_neural_hashes':86,'new_neural_modules':1,
    'actual_CPU_tests':45,'actual_CUDA_compatibility_calls':84,'restored_smoke_Adam_states':58,
    'exact_historical_control_trace_rows':122,'fixed_quality_cases':822,'fixed_endpoints':4,
    'document_links_checked':links,'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Preparation bytes,actual completed compatibility/smoke/test receipts,frozen new/old neural sources,all supplied quality files and historical exact control prefix. Final training,quality and actual native viewing remain pending. No restoration gain or safety guarantee.'})
print('PASS10 byte-exact receipts,30 sources,86 unchanged neural hashes,122 exact control rows,822 quality inputs and',links,'document links')
